Lookup types.title: Create a lookup
Lookup types.description: Creates a new lookup with its codes, or adds new codes to an existing one; nothing existing is changed.

fields.label: Lookup name
fields.help: Up to 30 characters. An existing lookup gets only the codes it doesn't have yet.

fields.label: Name shown to users
fields.help: Needed for a new lookup. Up to 80 characters; no other lookup may already use it.

fields.label: Module
fields.help: Needed for a new lookup.

fields.label: Only add codes to a lookup that already exists

Price Lists.title: Create a price list
Price Lists.description: Creates a price list, gives it access and approves it; existing ones are never changed.

fields.label: Price list name
fields.help: No single quotes (').

fields.label: Business unit
fields.help: Pick one that is known to work, or type another; it is checked with Oracle.

fields.label: Currency
fields.help: Pick one that is known to work, or type a code (USD) or name; it is checked with Oracle.

fields.label: Start date
fields.help: 'today' means Oracle's today minus one day.

Payment Terms.title: Create a payment term
Payment Terms.description: Creates a payment term with its installments; an existing term is never changed.

fields.label: Payment term name
fields.help: Up to 50 characters. Capital and small letters count: 'Net 30' and 'net 30' are two terms.

fields.label: From date
fields.help: 'today' means Oracle's today minus one day.

fields.label: Installments
fields.help: Each installment: a percent or an amount, and one way to set its due date. Percents add up to 100; with amounts the last installment is 0.

fields.label: Due on day of the month
First discount: day of the month
Second discount: day of the month
Third discount: day of the month

Order Types.title: Add an order type
Order Types.description: Adds a new order type that sales orders can use; existing ones are never changed.

fields.label: Order type code
fields.help: Up to 30 characters; capital and small letters count as different.

fields.label: Name shown to users
fields.help: Up to 80 characters; no other order type may already use it.

fields.label: Position in the list
fields.help: Empty: the next number after the last order type.

fields.label: Start date
fields.help: Empty: active right away. 'today' means Oracle's today minus one day.

Customers.title: Create a customer
Customers.description: Creates an organization or person customer with its account and address; an existing customer is never changed.

fields.label: Account address set
fields.help: Pick one that is known to work, or type another; it is checked with Oracle.

fields.label: Account established date
fields.help: Empty: Oracle's today. 'today' means Oracle's today minus one day.

fields.label: Address from date
fields.help: Empty: Oracle's today.

fields.label: Country
fields.help: Only the United States is offered so far (its address fields are proven).

fields.label: State
fields.help: Proven states; another one you type is checked with Oracle.

fields.label: City
fields.help: Must be a city Oracle knows in that state.

fields.label: Postal code
fields.help: Must be a postal code Oracle knows for that city.

fields.label: Responsible mineral status
fields.help: Conflict Free, N/A, No Data or Undetermined; checked with Oracle.

fields.label: Trading partner identifier
fields.help: Numbers only.

Business Units.title: Create a business unit
Business Units.description: These will always be set up: Order Manager and Pricing Administrator access for Configuration.TEST. More options add extra access on top of that, as a last step. An existing business unit is never changed; only missing access is added to it.

fields.label: Business unit name
fields.help: Up to 240 characters.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: Pick one that is known to work, or type another; it is checked with Oracle.

fields.label: Default set
fields.help: Pick one that is known to work, or type another; it is checked with Oracle.

fields.label: Manager
fields.help: Optional. Only Yaqub, Younas or Smith, Aron can be chosen.

fields.label: Extra access user
fields.help: Empty: Configuration.TEST. Gets the extra role below, after the required access is in place.

fields.label: Extra access role
fields.help: In addition to Order Manager and Pricing Administrator. Only roles that can be given for a business unit are listed.

fields.label: Second extra access role
fields.help: Optional, one more extra role for the same user.

fields.label: Check on screen too
fields.help: Also opens Oracle's own screens to look at the result (Manage Business Units, Users with Data Access, Create Order). Takes several minutes longer.
